content:
The fellowship of the Holy Spirit is not just to give us a warm fuzzy feeling, the prime desire of God is to bring us into Oneness with Himself, this is done by the Holy Spirit who raised Jesus from the dead the true and full expression of Oneness.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

You don't fight, work or even pray to be how you are, it is your natural state of being. This reality is true for the the Resurrected Christ, His Perfection is not a gift or an anointing, it's His natural state of being, it is Oneness with God, so it with all who are born of God, we are born into this state.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

When Jesus dead He went lower than any other being in existence had ever gone, His descent was not based on a sin committed, He BECAME sin itself. By the same right in His resurrection He did not go back to the same place He had before He was made Higher than the Heavens He brought a new state of being; PERFECTION! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Perfect state of man has nothing to do with religion or his mental well being, Perfection is about walking in the fullness of Christ and manifesting His person to all Creation. Perfection is the culmination of all Creation into the fullness of the risen Christ!
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not ones ability to be upright and avoid falling, the truth is it has nothing to do with standing or falling, it is the reality of Christ as He is. Christ is the same in every place where you may want to see Him, He is the same one who descended into the lowest depth and also ascended to the highest height, and He fills all in all, in every place He is the same. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

God desires us to see Christ as He is and be brought into the reality of How He is. Jesus is the manifest reality of God's original purpose of all creation, He is not just an example or one we are called to aspire to, He is the true purpose of all existence, He is the state of Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

For so long we have been made to believe that the whole essence of Christianity and the work of the Holy Spirit is to prepare us for Heaven, but the true is the Holy Spirit was given to us as a garrantee that the fullness of Sonship is available to us in Christ. Perfection is the end to training and preparation. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

There is a state where all the needs, questions and struggle ends, this is where you don't go through anything or aspire to be something. This is the fullness of God manifest in Christ, the state where all the desires of God for all creation are fulfilled and established; Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The concept of believing is based on the fact that one needs to look beyond their reality to hold on the truth in another realm. In Perfection one does not believe for anything, we have come unto the reality of all that was believed, we are the Manifestation of every promise and desire; Christ is the state of Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

We have lived in the revelation that all this (our lives on Earth) climaxes with all those who believe in Jesus being with Him forever in Heaven. The Truth is that is not the fullness of the plans and purpose of God, rather He desire to manifest Himself to and in all things; His original intent is bring all Creation into Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Word of God is Perfect, and its prime purpose is it's manifestation not its use. In ages past people used the Word to get what they needed, but the Word is Perfect before you ever needed anything it is Alive and Powerful, it does not need a negative situation to prove its efficacy. God's desire is to bring us into Oneness with the Word; this is Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The original purpose of God in giving us the Holy Spirit was not to display Power, it is to bring us into complete oneness and fellowship with Himself. The Holy Spirit is the one who brings out the fullness of God in us, and this is not a demonstration of Power rather it is the Manifestation of Creation being brought unto Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The reality of Christ is not manifest in His ability to provide solutions, rather it is in the Manifestation of His fullness to all Creation, bringing all things into His State; Perfection. The Love of God is manifested unto all Creation in Christ, not just to human beings, to fail to see that is to fail to acknowledge the Truth. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

We are called to rest not to death, many have the notion that death is equal to rest, but nothing could be further from the Truth. Rest is the Manifestation of the work of the risen Christ, it is coming to the end of all struggle, desire, need and growth. Rest is the fulfillment of all things for all Creation, this is Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Glory of Perfection is not in defeating of your enemies or in ones victory by overcoming, or breaking through something that had held them bound. Perfection is a state, it is the state of the risen Christ as He is. Perfection does not destory anything, He brings all things into His state. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The weight of the Lord's blessings on ones life, or the level of demonstration of His power and presence is not a measure of their closeness to Perfection. Perfection a state, it does not come in measures or doses, it cannot be attained by lessening ones vices, or straightening morals, Perfection is Christ as He is. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In past ages we were made to believe Perfection is impossible because the smallest iota of error, miscalculation or impurity could make the whole thing crumble. But nothing could be further from the truth, because when the worst mistake or evil comes in contact with Perfection it is pulled into Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The code of Perfection is in all things, all creation is groaning for the Manifestation of the Son's of God. Being Son's of God is not a theoritical concept or a confession, it is the vital reality of being born of God, a true offspring as Jesus is in the Ressurrection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

In the Church age, we lived by believing God's Word, all the provisions of Grace were accessed that way, In Perfection we are called to behold Him as He is, and as we see Him, we are changed into the very image and state, for we see Him as He is; Face to Face, Iris to Iris. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

That which is PERFECT is not brought about by the hand of man, it is not a product of prayer or meditation. Perfection is the working of the same power that raised Jesus from the dead, a reality that brings all creation into the state of the Resurrection, never to be corrupted again. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The limits experienced on the full manifestation of God's Power are set by the system under which each dispensation runs. Salvation by Grace through faith could not manifest under the Old Testament system, the same is true of the experience in Perfection, the fullness of God can only be the experience, when Perfection is in place. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The greatest injustice done to all mankind was to make God a construct of religion. The relationship between a product and it's manufacturer cannot be a religious one, much more Creation cannot relate or experience God in the confines of religion. Jesus is the Way, the Truth and the Life, there is nothing religious about that. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The most Powerful force in the Universe is that which the Father wrought when He raised Jesus from the dead, this Power is beyond both the physical and the spiritual, it brings all things unto Perfection. Nothing can escape this pull, it is the reality of God in all things, God's original intent for all things spiritual and physical. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Love is Perfection, the Father is not a God of Love, Love is How He is, that is to say that Love is what He does, who He is, where He is, and when He is. Love is not just the motivation of all His deeds, it's way more than that, It is HOW He is, it is His State; Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

What the Father wrought in all creation when He raised Jesus from the dead, is something that mankind is yet to come into, it has already been established and now creation awaits it's Manifestation through us. This is the 3rd day, the day Perfection the fullness of Christ manifested in the Son's of God; that which is PERFECT is come.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not the latest revelation, or the next big thing. Perfection has always been from before time began, it is God's original intent, the reality to which all revelations tend to. The reason for the salvation of mankind is the Father's desire to bring us into Perfection, the very state of the risen Christ. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not a gift or an anointing, it is the state of the risen Christ. It is not something to be preached or taught, it is the Manifestation of Christ bring all Creation into How He is. Perfection is reality.  
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The light of Truth is not dimmed by unbelief or doubt, in ages past the power of Truth was established when it was believed, In PERFECTION Truth is the imposing force, it pulls all things into it's reality and experience. This is the Father's House.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The fact that you cannot come into or experience what you don't understand shows that ones experience with God was based on the individual. In Perfection all things are based on Christ, He is the experience and reality of all Truth, all Creation is pulled into His state; not based on our ability to believe, but on the infinite power of His Love. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The culmination of all things is Creation being brought into Perfection by the Love of God, the Ressurrection of Christ is the fulfillment and Manifestation of the Love of God, anything that is not Perfect is not revealed in and by Love. Love is Perfection; it is How God is.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is not about making you a winner, or a high achiever, in the ressurrection God has brought us into the reality of how Jesus is. It's not a matter of who is higher or more powerful, it is the Manifestation of the state of Christ in all Creation; This is Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The view of reality that you have will define the reality that you will experience. What the Spirit of God is working in men is the change their view of reality, because if we don't see from the same plane that He is revealing truth from we wont experience the reality of what is being revealed. Jesus speaks in Perfection, He calls us into this experience. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Do not allow yourself to get caught up in the craze for more power, more revelation or more influence, all this is vanity and an endless chase. Christ is the end of all human and religious pursuits, the Holy Spirit brings us into fullness which is Permanent and Unchanging; this is Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

For many people the highest encounter with God is a move, a move of the spirit or wave of revival etc. Movement was meant to take us somewhere, the desire of God by the Holy Spirit is to bring us into a place that is permanent and unchanging. Perfection is expressed at rest not in motions. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris

In the times of the church, there have been various interpretations and revelations of Scripture and believing the wrong one would have grave consequences. In Perfection it's not about what you believe is it about the Manifestation of Christ, and there is only one way to do it, that is as He is. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Cross is the ending of a system, when we becames fully cognizant of the reality that was wrought for us at the Cross we transcend death, sin and every aspect of the fall. It is the Cross that made a way for Perfection to manifest, without the reality of the death of Christ there could be no establishment of Perfection, His death was Perfect. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

God does not do temporal works, He does not over look any area, the fingerprint on all His work is Perfection, all things that manifest around His Person are brought into the full expression of Himself. Perfection is not just something Jesus does, it is how He is, it is the fullness of His state. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

There are things that can not be solved or sorted out at this level of revelation and experience with God. The truth is what we need is not a deeper revelation or a greater experience, what we need is to leave what we have known and see God as He is, not are we, therein is PERFECTION! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

This is Perfection, that Christ is manifest and experienced in His state by all Creation, that all may see and come into His Fullness. Nothing and no one is left out, it cannot be Perfect if it doesn't encampus everything. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

You can only lose or gain something that you have worked for. The reality of how you are, is your state at Rest; this is the unchanging Manifestation of ones true essence. In the Resurrection Jesus has brought all Creation into the experience of HOW He is, the permanent state of Rest in His being; Perfection! 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The finish work of the death burial and resurrection of Jesus Christ, is not merely the salvation of souls and the populating of Heaven, It is bringing all Creation into Perfection, that's what He Rose from the dead for. Son's of God are manifesting the state of Christ to all Creation. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is the reality of all things in Perfection, He is the head of all Creation, that best that all things are. He is fullness totality of all things, All creation has been groaning for Him to be manifested through the Sons of God, those who are in the state of the risen Christ. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Life is not something biology can define, Life is the Manifestation of the Risen Christ, at His resurrection Jesus changed the meaning of life, He is not living, nor does He have life, He is the fullness of Life and it's very expression. This is Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection is the core reality of all things it cannot be undone or avoided, it is as Permanent and enduring as the risen Christ. This is the experience that all Creation has been groaning for, the Manifestation of the son's of God.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus came to give life to all that exists, Christ is the reality of Life as defined by God, not merely the biological makeup of organisms. At the Resurrection of Christ, the meaning and experience of life was changed and redefined forever, anything that is not in the state of Christ is not considered to be living, for He has brought all things unto Perfection.
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

God manifested the fullness of His strength when He raised Jesus from the dead, this was the one time when the fullness of the Glory of God was seen in it's totality by all Creation. Jesus is the State of Perfection to with all things now tend towards. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Perfection does not come by belief, it is not a product of confession and meditation. Perfection was wrought by the resurrection Power of God that raised Jesus from the dead, and changed the reality of all Creation to tend towards Christ. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

Jesus is not a representation of what religion should be, He is the fullness of Life and the manifestation of Creation. All things visible and invisible have there being in Him, He makes up all things; all systems and forces have meaning and existence in Him. He is Perfection. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

The Greatness of God's Love is in how He makes us Perfect! That's the Power and full revelation of Love, He brings us into the fullness of Himself and manifests His state to all Creation. Perfection is not a factor of Human ability it is the full manifestation of Love upon, and through someone or something. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*

God's divine purpose in the Old testament with Israel was to have a nation that kept His statutes, in the Church age He desired to have a personal relationship with all men to know Him as their Father. In PERFECTION God is bringing all Creation into the fullness of His state, not just to know Him but to be as He is. 
*#Teleiosis*
*#IrisToIris*
